methods.name: CheckGarantedAll
methods.description: When Verifying that all the permissions mentioned in the list have been allowed, it will return true or false.

methods.name: CheckMultiplePermissions
methods.description: Parses a whitelist and returns an event (ResultCheckMultiplePermission) with a denied and allowed whitelist.

methods.name: CheckSinglePermission
methods.description: Checks whether the mentioned permission has been granted, it will return true or false.

methods.name: RequestPermission
methods.description: In a list of permissions, a window will open for the user, whether or not to allow permissions that have not been granted.

name: listPermission
helpString:
